headword: {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}

definitions.explanation: Having exceptionally good academic results or performance, often used to describe students who consistently achieve top marks.

examples.japanese: {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}な{学生|がくせい}が{表彰|ひょうしょう}された。
examples.english: Students with excellent grades were recognized.

examples.japanese: {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}{者|しゃ}には{奨学金|しょうがくきん}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: Scholarships are awarded to those with outstanding academic performance.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}で{卒業|そつぎょう}し、{大手|おおて}{企業|きぎょう}に{就職|しゅうしょく}した。
examples.english: She graduated with outstanding grades and got a job at a major company.

notes:
A four-character compound of {成績|せいせき} (grades, results) + {優秀|ゆうしゅう} (excellent, outstanding). Functions as a noun phrase that modifies other nouns with な, as in {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}な{学生|がくせい}. Commonly used in academic and professional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}な{学生|がくせい}: student with excellent grades
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}{者|しゃ}: top achiever
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}で{卒業|そつぎょう}する: to graduate with honors
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}{賞|しょう}: academic excellence award

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {優等生|ゆうとうせい}: honor student — refers to the person, while {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう} describes the performance
- {秀才|しゅうさい}: prodigy, genius — implies natural talent, while {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう} focuses on actual results
